import sys
from collections import deque
pushes = 0
def main():
    global pushes
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n, m = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(m):
        u, v = int(data[2+2*i]), int(data[3+2*i])
        adj[u].append(v); adj[v].append(u)
    visited = [False]*n
    comps = 0
    for s in range(n):
        if visited[s]:
            continue
        comps += 1
        q = deque([s]); pushes += 1
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            if visited[u]:
                continue
            visited[u] = True          # BUG: committed on dequeue
            for v in adj[u]:
                if not visited[v]:
                    q.append(v); pushes += 1
    print(comps)
main()
print("__METRIC__", pushes)
